quote: Said driver having so yielded may proceed and the drivers of all other vehicles approaching the intersection on the through highway shall yield right-of-way to the vehicle about to enter or cross the through highway.

activation.condition: entering driver has first yielded and is about to enter or cross the through highway while another driver approaches the intersection on that highway

obligation.description: the approaching through-highway driver shall yield right-of-way to that entering vehicle
obligation.source_clause: shall yield right-of-way to the vehicle about to enter or cross the through highway

timing.description: after the entrant has yielded, while it is about to enter or cross and the other driver approaches the intersection
